Name: Improbable Farm
Author: illysmanx
Description:
[size=4][b][u]Description[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tribute goes to Goomay for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12130?tab=description]Impossible Farm[/url] - See '[b]Shout Outs[/b]' for more info.
This map builds off their original map, and includes Goomay's original tiny grenhouse, unmodified.  
Improbable Farm is about 2.4 times larger in screen realestate than the Impossible Farm - the added tiles add visual context clues, mostly as decoration, so that the player is centered on a widescreen monitor and the map fits more into the ingame maps that surround the player's farm like the Backwoods (north), Bus Stop (East) and Forest (south). [/color]

[size=4][b][u]Installation instructions[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1) Make sure to add the mod-helping frameworks listed in the Requirements section of this page. [/color][/size]
2) Start a new save game. Choose the [u]river farm type[/u] (fishing farm). 
3) Start clearing your farm on your first day! 

* Since this farm replaces the original River Farm, the cutscene of Robin and the Mayor welcoming the farmer (player) to Stardew Valley doesn't play. You'll just start with your tools, parsnip seeds, and a good reason to get out there and start exploring. 

[size=4][b][u]Main features[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Of note, Improbable Farm adds just enough tiles to place a silo, a fish pond, and a coop or barn. The pet bowl has been placed south, since pets often stand in your way when crossing this map area. [/color]

A tiny cave entrance has been added for going to the backwoods, and there's a mystery path you'll have to find your way through for a few more buildable tiles!
[spoiler]Hint, see the mod images for an example farm![/spoiler]
There's a set of minecarts hidden in the farm which teleport you to the southern section of the farm, and if you explore the west bank of the little stream, go downwards for the bus stop entry. 

Tillable tiles: 16
No multiplayer available with this modded map - there is no space for cabins! You can do multiplayer just fine with the vanilla farm maps while Improbable Farm is in your mods folder. 

[size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API on Nexus Mods[/url])  - [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_SMAPI]Installation instructions for SMAPI[/url][u] IMPORTANT to run the install files for SMAPI[/u]. 
Content Patcher ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher on NexusMods[/url]) - Install like regular stardew mods. Nexus Mod manager can handle this just fine for you.[/color]

[size=4][b][u]Shout outs[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A big thanks to Goomay for the brave work of setting out to make a completely from-scratch map for Stardew Valley! It's perfect for challenge runs and charming, to say the least. It must have been several months' worth of learning the Tiled app and troubleshooting the map before they were able to publish version 1, so respect! 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Goomay]Goomay[/url]'s original mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12130]Impossible Farm[/url] (at version 1.11 at time first posting of my modded version)[/color]
